go-scraper

A modern, high-performance web scraping library for Go with support for multiple extraction strategies.

Features

  • Multiple extraction strategies (Readability, Trafilatura, Colly)
  • Built-in caching with TTL support
  • Embed preservation for YouTube, Twitter, etc.
  • HTML sanitization for security
  • Paywall detection
  • Domain-specific extraction rules via YAML

Quick Start

go get github.com/aluknot/go-scraper
package main

import (
    "context"
    "fmt"
    "log"
    
    "github.com/aluknot/go-scraper"
)

func main() {
    result, err := scraper.Extract(context.Background(), "https://example.com/article", nil)
    if err != nil {
        log.Fatal(err)
    }
    fmt.Printf("Title: %s\n", result.Article.Title)
    fmt.Printf("Content: %s...\n", result.Article.Content[:100])
}
